name: FilmCraft
description: FilmCraft is an open-source nonlinear video editor written from scratch in pure Rust by the ArtCraft team, covering editing, color and sound. It ships as a native universal macOS app (DMG and Homebrew cask) and also runs on Windows and Linux. Like all Crafting Apps it is young and moving fast: v0.10.0 landed in October 2026.

zh.description: FilmCraft 是 ArtCraft 团队从零开始、用纯 Rust 编写的开源非线性视频编辑器，覆盖剪辑、调色与声音。提供 macOS universal 原生版本（DMG 与 Homebrew cask），同时支持 Windows 和 Linux。和所有 Crafting Apps 一样年轻而迭代飞快：v0.10.0 于 2026 年 10 月发布。

body.en: FilmCraft is the ArtCraft family's open-source nonlinear video editor, written from scratch in pure Rust — covering editing, color and sound.

body.en: It ships as a native universal macOS app (DMG and Homebrew cask) alongside Windows and Linux builds. Development moves fast — v0.10.0 landed in October 2026.
